verdict.rationale: Oyster's own docs state it offers developer sandboxes with seed data for integration development. That gives users a separate test environment for building and testing API integrations instead of working against live employment data. Missing for 10: detailed docs on how sandboxes are provisioned and how they are isolated from production (separate credentials or base URLs), sandbox-versus-production parity and limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: We offer developer sandboxes with some seed data to use for integration development.
